text.tspan: Self-Improving AI Agent by Nous Research | Narrow Waist Core - Infinite Capability at Edges

Turns, Tool Call Parsing, Retries, Role Alternation Guard

Strict role alternation (User -> Assistant -> Tool) | Auxiliary LLM Client (vision / summarization)

Browser Use cloud, Web search routed natively
Side tasks: Vision evaluation, context compression,
embedding creation without polluting main prompt

memory/ | context_engine/ | platforms/ | model-providers/ | kanban/ | image_gen/
